title: Floating point exception (core dumped) for nonzero_static operator

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: edge cases
labels.description: Adversarial inputs unlikely to occur in practice

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug
Executing the following script led to a core dump. This is a dangerous behavior. 
Note that using the default device for the `empty_tensor` will run well.



```python
import torch

empty_tensor = torch.tensor([], device='cuda:0')
result = torch.ops.aten.nonzero_static(empty_tensor, size=1)
```
